review_description: Owner, installer came out to quote the system. All the installers onsite are Electricians, cabling from panels to the inverter was very clean and tidy. Hand over was in detail and professional. They aren't the cheapest around but this is my second Solar System purchase and I've gone the cheapest in the past with only having to pull the system down after 5 Years.

Company owner came and inspected my property before providing a quotation (unlike one who did it from a satellite image). Company uses its own employees to do the installation not contractors. Installation was very efficient and follow up documentation provided promptly.
